summary: The explorer's relation verbs, its 'shown' status, the section counts and the history crumbs are set in the footnote role instead of label-sm with a font-regular override (#59). The history crumbs had the same override with no declared exception. The size and weight are unchanged (12px, 400). The leading moves from label-sm's 1.3 to footnote's 1.35, so a line is 16.2px instead of 15.6px.
